text: {"frames":["Anke pulls the bell rope, and a bell answers from under the floorboards, where the drowned village's church should not be. Water seeps up between the planks and carries a wooden clog past her ankle. The hoist beam creaks, and thirty glowing herring-bones swing down on a rope, waiting to be carried down the stairs. Each of the bell-ropes must get the same number of herring-bones, or the bells will ring out of step and the hoist will stay still. If thirty glowing herring-bones are shared out equally between the bell-ropes, how many does each rope get?","Something pressed into the rind of a cheese in the Tower's cellar is a map, and the map shows a canal nobody has ever drawn. Edith the ferrywoman says nothing at all, she only taps the map with her oar and points at the water. The canal has thirty sluice gates, and the boat can only pass once exactly half of them stand open. How many sluice gates must Edith open so that her boat can pass?","In the cheese cellar you may only speak in whispers, because the wheels keep time to the faraway music. The music is coming from somewhere behind the shelves, and it wants the cheeses split into two equal rows before it will play. Thirty wheels sit in one heap, and the cheese makers have to share them out exactly. How many wheels must go onto the left shelf so that the music starts?","The stairs lead up to a floor that is not on the plan, and the plan has just folded itself into a paper boat. Granny Angus sits by the window, knitting a scarf that has no end, and she has already cast on thirty stitches. She bets you a hot waffle that you cannot unpick exactly half of those stitches without dropping one. How many stitches must you unpick to win the waffle?","Hold still, the ice is singing, and the footprints are coming across the canal from nowhere. Ruun the fog collector runs with thirty jars held against her chest, and she needs to pour out exactly half of them into the hole in the ice before the footprints reach the edge. Each jar of fog that goes into the water stops the chase. How many jars must Ruun pour into the hole?"]}
